items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Edmund Conley finally put the Klan down when the band you know when we got together

ctx.x: no when we were rehearsing for the job before we went on the job I remember we was playing four nights I believe it was four nights that's all we was playing we were playing I believe it was either Monday or Wednesday Friday and a Saturday that's what it was Monday, Wednesday, Friday and a Saturday and well after when when we rehearsed the band that's when Joe Wynn picked up Edmund Hall and Albert Morgan and they still kept Edmund Washington but Washington like we were like the group that left here we all could…
was he playing alto or tenor or a band?
